title: Full Stack Digital Marketing & E-commerce Mastery | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Full Stack Digital Marketing & E-commerce Mastery. Category: Entrepreneurship. Duration: 4 months. Description: Introduction to computers, hardware & software, MS Office essentials, Google services and internet browsing, and startup planning and strategy for digital marketing and entrepreneurship. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
